column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the sea monster” (tannin) is rendered “the reptile.”
NKJV reads “a vineyard of red wine” (hemer) instead of “a vineyard of delight” (hemed), following some manuscripts.
Close to the Hebrew; the future “I will march… burn” is rendered “I would go through… I would burn.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my protection” is rendered “My strength.”
NKJV supplies “He shall cause,” making God the subject: “Those who come He shall cause to take root.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּסַּאסְּאָה (obscure) is rendered “In measure,” and “fierce” “rough.”
Close to the Hebrew; “atoned for” is rendered “covered,” and אֲשֵׁרִים “Wooden images.”
Close to the Hebrew; the singular “it” is rendered “them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “beat out” is rendered “thresh,” and “wadi of Egypt” “Brook of Egypt.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who were lost” is rendered “who are about to perish.”
